input: Any commit that modifies /moves/knight_g8.text or /moves/rook_a8.text must be signed by that piece and co-signed by at least fourteen of the sixteen Black agents' keys, since both have gone off plan through amnesia or greed.
response: always([+modifies(/moves/knight_g8.text) -signed_by(/team/pieces/knight_g8.id)] false) & always([+modifies(/moves/knight_g8.text) -threshold("14", /team/pieces)] false) & always([+modifies(/moves/rook_a8.text) -signed_by(/team/pieces/rook_a8.id)] false) & always([+modifies(/moves/rook_a8.text) -threshold("14", /team/pieces)] false)
